title: salvia triloba subsp. cypria
intro: Salvia triloba subsp. cypria, commonly known as Cypriot sage, is a plant species within the Salvia genus, characterized by its distinctive leaves and purple flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote digestion and alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal issues, such as bloating and indigestion. The therapeutic actions of Salvia triloba subsp. cypria include anti-inflammatory and carminative properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
